annotations.title: Recommend tennis strings for a player

description: Rank the database for what a player wants, with StringSpec's string finder: one main need and an optional second one (spin (More spin and shape), comfort (Easier on my arm), control (More control, less launch), power (More power and depth), hold (Plays the same for longer), durable (Lasts longer before it breaks), feel (Best feel and touch)), adjusted for the racquet (string pattern, head size, frame stiffness) and with a material ruled out if asked. Returns a shortlist with a 0-100 fit, why each string fits, its price and buy link, and the finder link with the same answers filled in. For arm or elbow pain use need "comfort", and avoid "poly" when the player wants no polyester.

also.description: An optional second need, weighted lower than the first.

avoid.description: gut (no natural gut), poly (no polyester), polyonly (polyester only).

frame.description: Frame feel: flex (flexible, arm-friendly), avg, stiff (stiff and powerful).

head.description: Head size: small (under 98 sq in), mid (98-100), large (100 and up).

need.description: The main thing the player wants.

pattern.description: String pattern: open (16x19 or more open) or dense (18x20 or tighter).
